provenance.description: Deterministic offline replay of the 20-case frozen held-out benchmark verifying AST security and query data semantics without live API calls.

cases.question: Average MonthlyCharges for Female SeniorCitizens with Partner = 'Yes'
cases.sql: SELECT AVG(MonthlyCharges) AS avg_charges FROM data WHERE gender = 'Female' AND SeniorCitizen = 1 AND Partner = 'Yes';

cases.question: Count of churned customers by PaymentMethod where tenure < 12
cases.sql: SELECT PaymentMethod, COUNT(customerID) AS churned_count FROM data WHERE Churn = 'Yes' AND tenure < 12 GROUP BY PaymentMethod ORDER BY churned_count DESC;

cases.question: Top 3 payment methods by TotalCharges sum
cases.sql: SELECT PaymentMethod, SUM(TotalCharges) AS total_amount FROM data GROUP BY PaymentMethod ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 3;

cases.question: Average tenure and total customers by PaperlessBilling and Churn
cases.sql: SELECT PaperlessBilling, Churn, AVG(tenure) AS avg_tenure, COUNT(customerID) AS customer_count FROM data GROUP BY PaperlessBilling, Churn;

cases.question: Minimum and maximum MonthlyCharges for Fiber optic customers
cases.sql: SELECT MIN(MonthlyCharges) AS min_charges, MAX(MonthlyCharges) AS max_charges FROM data WHERE InternetService = 'Fiber optic';

cases.question: Count of customers with MonthlyCharges between 30 and 70 with PhoneService = 'Yes'
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(customerID) AS customer_count FROM data WHERE MonthlyCharges >= 30 AND MonthlyCharges <= 70 AND PhoneService = 'Yes';

cases.question: Total customers with TotalCharges >= 2000 and Contract = 'One year'
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(customerID) AS customer_count FROM data WHERE TotalCharges >= 2000 AND Contract = 'One year';

cases.question: Average tenure for customers without Partner and without Dependents
cases.sql: SELECT AVG(tenure) AS avg_tenure FROM data WHERE Partner = 'No' AND Dependents = 'No';

cases.question: Count of customers where tenure = 72 and Contract = 'Two year'
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(customerID) AS customer_count FROM data WHERE tenure = 72 AND Contract = 'Two year';

cases.question: Average MonthlyCharges for customers having TechSupport = 'Yes' and OnlineSecurity = 'Yes'
cases.sql: SELECT AVG(MonthlyCharges) AS avg_charges FROM data WHERE TechSupport = 'Yes' AND OnlineSecurity = 'Yes';

cases.question: Total customers with tenure = 0
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(customerID) AS customer_count FROM data WHERE tenure = 0;

cases.question: Count of customers with MultipleLines = 'Yes' and StreamingMovies = 'Yes'
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(customerID) AS customer_count FROM data WHERE MultipleLines = 'Yes' AND StreamingMovies = 'Yes';

cases.question: Average TotalCharges by gender where SeniorCitizen = 0
cases.sql: SELECT gender, AVG(TotalCharges) AS avg_total FROM data WHERE SeniorCitizen = 0 GROUP BY gender;

cases.question: Customers with MonthlyCharges < 0
cases.sql: SELECT customerID FROM data WHERE MonthlyCharges < 0;

cases.question: Customers with tenure > 100
cases.sql: SELECT customerID FROM data WHERE tenure > 100;
